002.name: Marisa
002.text: Looks like I finally reached somewhere important.

003.name: Marisa
003.text:
That moon looks pretty menacing. That's not an ordinary
			shade of red.

004.name: Marisa
004.text:
Forget about canon fodder youkai. If this keeps up,
			demons might start appearing on the surface.

011.name: Marisa
011.text: Oh, luckily I can speak in the demonic tongues.

013.name: Marisa
013.text: How are you doing, fellow crewmate?

017.name: Remilia
017.text: Well, I'd like to assure you I'm not a (true) demon.

018.name: Marisa
018.text:
Good to hear, I thought I was in real trouble there for a second.
			Especially because I don't actually know how to speak demon
			that well.

019.name: Remilia
019.text: Especially because we aren't even speakig demonic right now.

020.name: Marisa
020.text:
Really? I thought you had casted a Babelfish spell or something.
			What we are speaking is pretty demonic sounding, no?

021.name: Remilia
021.text:
I'm pretty sure this is a normal human language though?
			From the outside? French?

022.name: Marisa
022.text: Never heard of that one, guess one of my books was mislabeled.

023.name: Remilia
023.text:
Ah whatever. Would you like some tea and pastries? I am having
			a few snacks while the ritual finishes.

024.name: Marisa
024.text: Oh yes, the scary moon thing. Why did you do that?

025.name: Remilia
025.text:
The sun is the natural enemy of vampires of course!
			I'd like to get some fresh air while everyone else is awake.

026.name: Remilia
026.text: Only being awake during the night gets lonely sometimes you know?

027.name: Remilia
027.text:
And besides, there is a certain someone who I'm trying to get to 
			go outside more.

028.name: Remilia
028.text:
With the sun out of the way, maybe she'll finally spend some 
			time with her lovely sister.

029.name: Marisa
029.text:
Don't you think that's a bit too much. Plenty of living creatures 
			depend on the sun you know.

030.name: Remilia
030.text:
Don't worry it's just a temporary thing. Once it finishes,
			I'll leave it up for a few days and then I can reverse it.

032.name: Marisa
032.text: Sounds like I'll have to stop you then.

033.name: Remilia
033.text: Well I more or less expected this to happen.

034.name: Remilia
034.text: Come at me then! The night is forever young!
